testimonies.testimony: I was ingesting a regulation beef steak at the restaurant while having a tactical discussion with the old man.
Myself, I was extolling the virtues of a particularly fine golden curio to the military gentleman.
At that precise moment, a firearm was discharged! I observed the enemy's actions with my own eyes!
The black-uniformed varsity cadet fired on the English civilian! And from the back, the cowardly little weasel!

turns.summarizedContext: The witness Nosa is testifying about everything he saw at the precise moment that the incident occurred.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims the victim is shot from the back.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests the victim is shot from the chest. Further, bullet did not pass through the body.
Prop 1: If the witness don't have a wound from the back, then he cannot be shot from back.
